question: In 2019, the Uttar Pradesh government created a world record by planning over 22 crore saplings in one day on 77th anniversary of the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Quit India Movement.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Uttar Pradesh launched the 'Vriksharopan Mahakumbh' campaign to commemorate the 77th anniversary of the **Quit India movement.**__
 
• It was a massive greenery initiative with the goal of planting a state-record** 22 crore saplings.**
